toc.note_zh: 全书由三篇长论组成（图表、地图、树），章题据通行版式；具体小节未逐页核对。
toc.note_en: Three long essays (graphs, maps, trees); titles follow the common edition, subsections not checked page by page.

plot_acts.title_zh: 图表：把文学史变成可数的对象
plot_acts.zh: Moretti 用出版年、文类与国别的计数曲线，展示文学生产的宏观节律；单个文本退到背景，取而代之的是文类的生灭。
plot_acts.en: Moretti plots publication years, genres and national literatures as curves, showing the macro-rhythm of production; individual texts recede and genres rise and fall instead.

brief.main: 不读文本也能看见文学史的形状，只要把文本变成数据。
brief.flow: 从计数方法，到文类曲线，再到解释的边界。
brief.sources: 书目数据库与文学史统计。
brief.link: 为后两篇（地图、树）提供量化的基调。
brief.main_en: The shape of literary history is visible without reading texts, if texts become data.
brief.flow_en: From counting to genre curves to the limits of explanation.
brief.link_en: Sets the quantitative key for maps and trees.

plot_acts.title_en: Maps: putting the novel back into space
plot_acts.zh: 把小说的地点标在地图上，可以看出文类与地理的相互塑造：首都、边境、殖民地与乡村各有其叙事功能。
plot_acts.en: Plotting novelistic locations on maps reveals how genre and geography shape each other: capital, border, colony and countryside each carry narrative functions.

brief.main: 空间不是背景，而是形式的构成要素。
brief.flow: 从地点标注，到空间模式，再到文类差异。
brief.link: 把量化的抽象拉回地理的具体。
brief.main_en: Space is not background but a constituent of form.
brief.flow_en: From plotting locations to spatial patterns to genre difference.
brief.link_en: Pulls quantitative abstraction back to geographical concreteness.

plot_acts.zh: 用树状图表示文类与形式的分叉，把达尔文式的演化隐喻引入文学史：形式有谱系，也有灭绝。
plot_acts.en: Tree diagrams represent the branching of genres and forms, importing an evolutionary metaphor into literary history: forms have lineages and extinctions.

brief.main: 形式像物种一样分化、竞争与消失。
brief.flow: 从形式特征，到分叉图，再到演化解释。
brief.link: 把三篇统一为一种「宏观形式学」。
brief.main_en: Forms branch, compete and vanish like species.
brief.flow_en: From formal features to branching diagrams to evolutionary explanation.
brief.link_en: Unifies the three essays as a macro-formalism.

plot_acts.title_en: Distant reading: making 'not reading' a method
plot_acts.zh: Moretti 主张文学史不必从细读出发：通过文类、市场与地理的宏观数据，可以看见单篇文本看不见的模式。
plot_acts.en: Moretti argues literary history need not start from close reading: macro-data on genre, market and geography reveal patterns invisible in single texts.

brief.main: 距离是认识的条件，而不是理解的障碍。
brief.flow: 从细读的局限，到宏观方法，再到解释的尺度。
brief.link: 为全书确立方法论姿态。
brief.main_en: Distance is a condition of knowledge, not an obstacle to understanding.
brief.flow_en: From the limits of close reading to macro-methods to scales of explanation.

plot_acts.title_zh: 世界文学作为一个体系
plot_acts.zh: 把世界文学理解为不平等交换的体系：中心提供形式，边缘提供材料与市场，创新往往发生在半边缘。
plot_acts.en: World literature is read as a system of unequal exchange: centres supply forms, peripheries supply material and markets, and innovation often emerges in the semi-periphery.

brief.main: 文学的世界性来自不平等，而非普世价值。
brief.flow: 从中心/边缘，到形式流动，再到半边缘的创新。
brief.names: 歌德、卡萨诺瓦、世界文学市场。
brief.sources: 世界文学理论与书目数据。
brief.link: 把远读从方法提升为全球文学史模型。
brief.main_en: Literary worldliness comes from inequality, not universal value.
brief.flow_en: From centre/periphery to the flow of forms to semi-peripheral innovation.
brief.link_en: Raises distant reading from method to a model of global literary history.

plot_acts.zh: 以具体实验收尾：文类演化、叙事句法、标题与篇幅的统计，展示远读能提出什么样的问题。
plot_acts.en: Concrete experiments close the book: genre evolution, narrative syntax, statistics of titles and length show what kinds of questions distant reading can pose.

brief.main: 远读的价值不在结论，而在它能提出新问题。
brief.flow: 从假设，到数据，再到解释的限度。
brief.link: 把方法论落成可检验的案例。
brief.main_en: The value of distant reading lies in new questions, not conclusions.
brief.flow_en: From hypothesis to data to the limits of explanation.
brief.link_en: Grounds the method in testable cases.

plot_acts.title_zh: 形容词：布尔乔亚的自我描述
plot_acts.zh: Moretti 从 19 世纪小说中反复出现的形容词入手，追踪「严肃」「舒适」「有用」等词如何构成布尔乔亚的自我形象。
plot_acts.en: Starting from adjectives recurring in nineteenth-century fiction, Moretti traces how words like serious, comfortable and useful compose the bourgeois self-image.

brief.main: 阶级不是先存在再被描述，而是在词汇中被做成。
brief.flow: 从词频，到语义场，再到阶级形象。
brief.names: 布尔乔亚、小说家、形容词。
brief.link: 为后两章的形式分析提供语言证据。
brief.main_en: A class is not described after it exists; it is made in vocabulary.
brief.flow_en: From word frequency to semantic fields to class image.
brief.link_en: Supplies linguistic evidence for the formal analyses that follow.

plot_acts.zh: 布尔乔亚的文体不是华丽的，而是清晰、功能性的散文；这种「平淡」本身就是一种意识形态。
plot_acts.en: The bourgeois style is not ornate but clear, functional prose; its very plainness is an ideology.

brief.main: 透明性是一种修辞，而不是修辞的缺席。
brief.flow: 从文体特征，到叙事功能，再到意识形态。
brief.sources: 小说文本细读与文体统计。
brief.link: 把语言分析与阶级分析接合。
brief.main_en: Transparency is a rhetoric, not the absence of rhetoric.
brief.flow_en: From stylistic features to narrative function to ideology.

plot_acts.title_zh: 胜利与失败：一个阶级的文学命运
plot_acts.title_en: Victory and defeat: the literary fate of a class
plot_acts.zh: 布尔乔亚在小说中既有胜利时刻，也逐渐失去叙事中心；Moretti 把这一曲线读成阶级的历史命运。
plot_acts.en: The bourgeoisie has its victories in fiction and then loses narrative centrality; Moretti reads this curve as the historical fate of a class.

brief.main: 文学形式的兴衰，是阶级命运的仪表盘。
brief.flow: 从叙事中心，到形式衰退，再到历史解释。
brief.names: 布尔乔亚、小说形式、19 世纪。
brief.link: 把微观词汇分析与宏观历史叙事合并。
brief.main_en: The rise and fall of literary form is a dashboard of class fate.
brief.flow_en: From narrative centrality to formal decline to historical explanation.
brief.names_en: Bourgeoisie, novel form, the nineteenth century.
brief.link_en: Merges micro-vocabulary analysis with macro-historical narrative.

plot_acts.zh: 把 19 世纪欧洲小说的故事地点标在地图上，可以看到文类与国土、边境、殖民地的关系。
plot_acts.en: Mapping where nineteenth-century European novels take place reveals relations between genre and nation, border and colony.

brief.main: 小说的地理不是随机的，而是被文类与国家结构塑造的。
brief.flow: 从地图标注，到空间模式，再到文类解释。
brief.names: 巴尔扎克、狄更斯、司汤达。
brief.link: 为文类的地理分析奠定基础。
brief.main_en: Novelistic geography is not random but shaped by genre and state structure.
brief.flow_en: From mapping to spatial pattern to generic explanation.
brief.link_en: Grounds the geographical analysis of genre.

plot_acts.zh: 不同文类占据不同空间：成长小说走向首都，冒险小说走向边境与殖民地，乡土小说退回乡村。
plot_acts.en: Genres occupy different spaces: the Bildungsroman moves to the capital, adventure fiction to border and colony, regional fiction back to the countryside.

brief.main: 文类是有地理的：形式选择也是空间选择。
brief.flow: 从文类分布，到空间功能，再到形式差异。
brief.names: 成长小说、冒险小说、乡土小说。
brief.link: 把「文类」从时间概念改为空间概念。
brief.main_en: Genres have geographies: formal choice is also spatial choice.
brief.flow_en: From generic distribution to spatial function to formal difference.
brief.link_en: Turns genre from a temporal into a spatial concept.

plot_acts.zh: 结论主张地图不是辅助材料，而是文学分析的形式工具：它让「在哪里发生」成为可解释的问题。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion argues maps are not ancillary but formal instruments of analysis: they make 'where it happens' an explicable question.

brief.main: 空间分析补充而非取代文本分析。
brief.flow: 从案例，到方法，再到文学史主张。
brief.link: 为《图表、地图、树》的地图篇铺路。
brief.main_en: Spatial analysis supplements rather than replaces textual analysis.
brief.flow_en: From cases to method to a claim about literary history.
brief.link_en: Prepares the maps essay in Graphs, Maps, Trees.

plot_acts.zh: Jockers 主张把数千部小说当作一个语料库来分析：词频、句法与主题的模式，只有在规模上才可见。
plot_acts.en: Jockers treats thousands of novels as one corpus: patterns of word frequency, syntax and theme become visible only at scale.

brief.main: 规模本身是一种解释工具。
brief.flow: 从细读传统，到语料库构建，再到模式识别。
brief.names: 19 世纪小说、语料库、统计方法。
brief.sources: 数字人文方法与小说语料。
brief.link: 为后续的文类与影响分析奠基。
brief.main_en: Scale is itself an instrument of explanation.
brief.flow_en: From the close-reading tradition to corpus building to pattern recognition.
brief.link_en: Grounds the later analyses of genre and influence.

plot_acts.zh: 通过词频与风格距离，Jockers 展示文类不是评论家的分类，而是可以在文本中测量出的差异。
plot_acts.en: Through word frequencies and stylistic distance, Jockers shows genre is not only a critic's category but a difference measurable in texts.

brief.main: 文类有可测量的语言指纹。
brief.flow: 从特征词，到风格距离，再到文类聚类。
brief.link: 把文类研究从解释转成检验。
brief.flow_en: From feature words to stylistic distance to genre clustering.
brief.link_en: Turns genre study from interpretation into testing.

plot_acts.zh: 以文本相似度构建影响网络，Jockers 让「谁影响了谁」从印象判断变成可检验的关系结构。
plot_acts.en: Building influence networks from textual similarity, Jockers turns 'who influenced whom' from impression into a testable relational structure.

brief.main: 影响不是灵感，而是可追踪的文本关系。
brief.flow: 从相似度，到网络，再到文学史叙事。
brief.link: 把宏观分析推到文学史的核心问题。
brief.main_en: Influence is not inspiration but a traceable textual relation.
brief.flow_en: From similarity to network to literary-historical narrative.
brief.link_en: Pushes macroanalysis to the core question of literary history.
